svg.aria-label: Tiger Team mission in Claude Code: the lead picks six experts, routes their handoffs and returns a consolidated verdict

g.text: ❯ /tiger-team:mission Migrate the nightly accounting chain from VTOM to Control-M:
IBM i extraction → CFT transfer → SAP IDocs. New firewall flows. Banking (DORA). release
Mission framed. Sector: banking (DORA). Mode: release. Collecting environment facts…
Team: enterprise-architect (framing + review) and 5 experts in parallel — about 30 agent calls.
enterprise-architect shadow run then atomic cut-over, 6 principles, end-to-end NFRs, 12 coherence findings
scheduling-expert 13-job smart folder, restart matrix, LOCK_GL lock, SLA alerts, no trigger in the DST hour
ibmi-expert read-only extraction, .ctl control file, UTF-8 conversion, lock data area, IBM i agent
integration-expert CFT in mutual TLS, RUN_ID propagation, reconciliation points R0–R4, replay, contract
erp-expert IDoc background processing, OBJ_KEY duplicate check, jobs S0–S4, reversal by BAPI
infra-expert flow matrix (~15 flows), PKI, sizing and hardening, firewall calendar and DR
Handoffs routed: ibmi→scheduling (journal lock in the window) · integration→infra (CFT ack flow) · ibmi→erp (CCSID)
Verdict: NO-GO today — 11 blocking criteria, 3 with no result yet.
▲ Risk #1: double posting. Blocked four ways: shared lock, CFT transfer register, exact IDoc count, OBJ_KEY check.
▲ The OBJ_KEY duplicate check is not proven: replay test required in pre-production before 2026-11-20.
● Recommended cut-over: night of 2027-02-09, after the year-end close. Business decision — yours (§ 8).
● Urgent: firewall request to file by 2026-10-27.
Deliverables: risk matrix (14) · 9 arbitrations · action plan · release sheet with rollback · 5 open questions
